remarks: This is it!! Welcome to 16 Eastwood! This updated split has it all! Main level features include spacious foyer, half bath, beautiful living room with crown molding, built ins and a fireplace, open concept kitchen to dining room with doors that lead to a spacious professionally landscaped backyard with a blue stone patio. Over the 2 car garage is an updated primary suite with walk in closet, office and primary bath. At the other end of the house the upper level features 3 bedrooms and updated full bath. On the lower level there is a bedroom, full bath and large living room with plenty of closet space- could be a great au-pair or in-law suite! Legal accessory apartment! Hardwood floors throughout! Heated garage! All offers must be submitted by 3:00 Tuesday April 21
